content.caption: Red cross icon marking disabled wiki access in the WikiSkill ablation table
content.description: A small red 'X' (cross) icon made of two thick diagonal strokes on a white background, with no text. On the page it is the cross mark used in Table 3, the ablation study of WikiSkill with Gemini-3.5-Flash. It means that a WikiSkill component does NOT have wiki access during skill evolution, in contrast to the green check mark, which means access is enabled. Crosses appear in three places in the table. First, the Skill Proposer Wiki Access column of the second row, where the Inference Agent has access but the Skill Proposer does not (average 45.3). Second, both the Inference Agent and Skill Proposer columns of the third row, where neither has access (average 48.7). Third, the Inference Agent Wiki Access column of the bottom row, which is the default WikiSkill configuration in which only the Skill Proposer has wiki access (average 63.7, the best). According to the caption, when the Skill Proposer carries a cross, the Wiki Maintainer is also removed, so no persistent knowledge accumulates across iterations.
